entries.claim: When the cube is crowded by another cube near the fingers, review alignment before commanded closure and verify a lift before changing to placement. A measured-aperture guard can wake only after a contact-driven missed grasp has developed; use before-command closure review and a short release for the contact transition when alignment remains uncertain.
entries.conditions: VideoPlaceOrder pickup with adjacent objects and uncertain finger clearance. Initial110-control authorization returned after96 controls; dense review showed first clear tilt/displacement at offset90, measured gripper event at91, and empty-lift confirmation later. Earlier unsampled precursor timing is unknown. This supports closer contact review, not a universal short approach budget or a proven safe16-control bound. Compared with active task entries, duration-71cda2a8269dbb0f5c13d845 is only a full-phase prior and has no contact-risk advice.

entries.claim: If final cube-to-target alignment is uncertain, arrange review before the placement gripper opens; an after-measured release guard may be preempted by official termination during opening. Keep clear transport separate from the release decision, and use a short reviewed release for that transition.
entries.conditions: VideoPlaceOrder placement after a recovered or visibly eccentric grasp, or with the hand obscuring final centering. An80-control placement authorization ended in official failure after69 controls during opening, before an after-measured guard returned. Sparse-to-dense review showed plausible descent but did not establish the failure cause or an exact earlier visual risk onset; earlier review is an opportunity to check alignment, not proven prevention.
